title: Topology-Aware Representation Alignment for Semi-Supervised Vision-Language Learning
abstract: arXiv:2604.26370v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Vision-language models have shown strong performance, but they often generalize poorly to specialized domains. While semi-supervised vision-language learning mitigates this limitation by leveraging a small set of labeled image-text pairs together with abundant unlabeled images, existing methods remain fundamentally pairwise and fail to model the global structure of multimodal representation manifolds. Most existing topology-based alignment methods rely on persistence diagram matching, which neither guarantees geometric alignment nor uses the image-text pairing information central to vision-language learning. We propose Topology-Aware Representation Alignment for Semi-Supervised Vision-Language Learning (ToMA), a framework that uses persistent homology to decompose pairwise relations into $H_0$-death and $H_1$-birth relations and aligns them across modalities through available cross-modal correspondences. translated_title: 面向半监督视觉-语言学习的拓扑感知表示对齐
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言模型已展现出强大的性能，但它们在专业领域的泛化能力往往较差。半监督视觉-语言学习通过利用少量带标注的图文对和大量无标注图像来缓解这一局限，然而现有方法从根本上仍是成对式的，无法建模多模态表示流形的全局结构。大多数现有的基于拓扑的对齐方法依赖于持续图匹配，这既不能保证几何对齐，也没有利用对视觉-语言学习至关重要的图文配对信息。我们提出了面向半监督视觉-语言学习的拓扑感知表示对齐框架ToMA，该框架利用持续同调将成对关系分解为 $H_0$-消亡关系与 $H_1$-诞生关系，并通过可用的跨模态对应关系在模态之间对这些关系进行对齐。这一轻量级的分解……
tldr: 提出ToMA框架，利用持续同调将图文成对关系分解为H0-消亡与H1-诞生两类关系，并通过跨模态对应在模态间对齐，从而捕捉多模态表示流形的全局拓扑结构，提升半监督视觉-语言学习的泛化能力。
